## Tips & gotchas

- Strong and gentle force is key when pulling the tight reservoir off. [t762]
- Use split loom where tubes go around sharp corners to prevent kinking. [t762]
- Use sheet metal as a spark shield if using a Dremel near sensitive components. [t762]
- The lower shelf has two layers of steel; drill through both before adding nuts underneath. [t762]
- The main battery should be closest to the cab, with the auxiliary in the very front. [t762]
- If using a National Luna kit, buy your own lugs as they can be cheap and not great quality. [t762]
- [Partial] Use plenty of tape on the wire end to create a smooth slope for easy grommet passage. [t762]
- [Partial] The center console pull-up requires gentle force; don't rip it off. [t762]
- Holding down the SET button silences the alarm after a successful setup. [t762]
